title: Hospital Ward
goal: A practitioner can read the hospital ward artefact at a glance.

rubric.must: A visible YOU ARE HERE marker, legend, and two marked exits are present.
Primary and secondary routes visibly lead from the marker to separate exits.
A reader can visually follow the principal flow or relationship from beginning to end.
Key labels remain legible and attached to the correct visible elements.
Lines and symbols do not visually imply unintended connections.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG visibly connects the YOU ARE HERE marker to separate exits with differentiated primary and secondary routes, while the picture provides only disconnected corridor arrows.
